text:
sasha: Heads-up: PR #4821 (hotfix/corrupt-cache) is ready for merge but blocked on approval. The infra change is trivial (1-line) and fixes a production NPE. We need two reviewers to sign off before today's 14:10 UTC merge window (~20m).
emily: @sasha linking the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 :eyes: I'll take a pass now.
raj: I can review in ~10m, tagging @kevin in case someone else can approve faster.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'm in. Quick note: CI flaky on ubuntu-20 runner, but tests that failed are unrelated per logs.
deploy-bot: Reminder: merge window cutoff in 20 minutes. Auto-merge disabled for hotfix branch. Run `gh pr merge 4821 --squash --body 'hotfix'` after 2 approvals.
sasha: If someone can give a formal approval comment like `LGTM` or click the approve button, that's enough. This change touches caching logic, so two approvals required per policy.
emily: Left small nit about a log message; not blocking. Approving now. LGTM :white_check_mark:
raj: Reviewed and ran local repro. Approving — looks safe. :rocket:
kevin: Thanks — pushing the merge now per release checklist.
sasha: Merged and kicked canary deploy. Watching metrics. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release hotfix-4821. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/4821
emily: Canary metrics look clean after 5m. No error spike. :tada:
raj: Good catch, team. I'll follow up with a postmortem note in incidents later.
